name: Is it better to patch or re-texture a popcorn ceiling?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to patch or re-texture a popcorn ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between patching or re-texturing a popcorn ceiling depends on the extent of the damage and your desired aesthetic. Small, isolated damage can often be patched, carefully matching the existing texture. However, matching popcorn texture perfectly can be challenging, and repairs might be noticeable. If the damage is extensive, or if you prefer a modern look, re-texturing the entire ceiling to a smooth finish or a different texture might be a more effective long-term solution for a uniform appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Patching is suitable for small, isolated popcorn ceiling damage, but re-texturing the entire ceiling might be better for extensive damage or a modern aesthetic.
